fair_value_reason: Value at 2027-10-09, before ~$4.7 of dividends; every method is an estimate built on inputs re-opened at source, with the peer multiples rebuilt from filings and consensus by the citation gate (2026-10-12). (1) P/E, weight 0.4: FY2027 consensus $14.44 (StockAnalysis, non-GAAP adjusted). FY2028 = 14.44 x 1.10 = $15.88. Oct-2027 NTM = 0.25 x 14.44 + 0.75 x 15.88 = $15.52, less 3% = $15.05 (the 3% matches my EBITDA haircut: a $0.6B shortfall is ~$0.45B after tax, or ~$0.45 a share, ~3% of $14.44). x 10.25x (+8% on the 9.50x core NTM median) = $154.3. (2) EV/EBITDA, weight 0.3: 2027 Core Adj. EBITDA $39.4B ($40.0B low end less 1.5%). Horizon LTM = 0.25 x 37.3 + 0.75 x 39.4 = $38.875B. Multiple 6.14x on the company basis (core peer median 6.53x x 1.05 = 6.86x on the lease-inclusive peer basis, / 1.118, where 1.118 = TMUS 7.69x on that basis [(159.38 + 86.92 debt + 3.461 towers + 29.058 operating leases - 2.825 cash) / 35.902] / 6.878x on the company basis [(159.38 + 84.095 + 3.461) / 35.902]). EV $238.6B - $84.095B net debt (held flat) - $3.461B towers = $151.1B / 1,005M = $150.3. (3) FCF yield, weight 0.3: horizon LTM AFCF = 0.25 x $18.6B (2026 guide midpoint) + 0.75 x $19.1B (2027 estimate) = $18.975B / 1,005M = $18.88 at 11.75% = $160.7. Blend: 0.4 x 154.3 + 0.3 x 150.3 + 0.3 x 160.7 = 61.7 + 45.1 + 48.2 = $155.0. Versus the agents ($159.6-166, mean $163.1) it is lower because their P/E and EV/EBITDA anchors were aggregator figures; on filed data the peer medians are lower and TMUS's current premium larger. Sensitivities: each 10M shares is ~$1.5 a share on the EV and FCF legs (~$0.9 on the blend); net debt at 2.3x is -$1.6 on the blend; +/-0.25x on the P/E is +/-$1.5 on the blend; +/-0.25x on the peer-basis EV/EBITDA is +/-$2.6 on the blend.
supervisor_summary: TMUS sits at $148.58 after a 13.3% drop on SpaceX's Grain 800 MHz deal, a threat whose service launch is targeted for H1 2028, after the horizon. The company maintains 2027 targets of $40-41B Core EBITDA and $19.5-20.5B AFCF, and its verified Q3 guide still shows EBITDA growing faster than revenue. After re-verifying every input, rebuilding the peer multiples from filings and consensus (the agents used aggregator figures) and settling the round-2 disputes (1,005M shares, net debt held flat, a 10.25x P/E, a 1.5% EBITDA haircut, TIMB/ORA out of the median, YipitData kept as context), the reconciled Oct-2027 fair value is $155, about 5% below the agents' mean, and the ladder is the agents' mean scaled to it (median ~$147). The thesis breaks below $115 (~8x FY27 EPS, Verizon's multiple); the next tests are AT&T and Verizon on Oct 21 and 26, the FOMC on Oct 27-28 and Q3 on Oct 28.
key_drivers: The 2027 framework is intact on paper and the Q3 guide still shows operating leverage. Targets: Core Adj. EBITDA $40.0-41.0B, AFCF $19.5-20.5B (Feb 2026 8-K), maintained on Sept 3. Q3 guide: EBITDA ~$9.4B (+8.3%) on service revenue ~$19.3B (+5.8%) (Q2 call; Q2 Factbook bases). I haircut 2027 EBITDA by only 1.5% ($39.4B).

Valuation is undemanding: 10.3x FY2027 consensus EPS ($148.58 / $14.44; 10.63x NTM) and an 11.54% trailing FCF yield, between T (11.60%) and VZ (12.44%), despite a 17.03% 3Y EPS growth forecast vs 6.99% (VZ) and 11.06% (T). I give it +8% to the 9.50x filings-based core peer median (10.25x).

Buybacks within an authorized envelope: $8.5B left in the $18.2B 2026 program at 2026-07-17 (10-Q R21) and up to ~$30B of returns through 2027 (Feb 2026 8-K) take the count to ~1,005M by Oct 2027 with net debt flat at $84.1B (leverage drifts to ~2.2x vs a 2.5x target).

SpaceX is a multiple overhang, not a P&L event, within the horizon. The Grain 800 MHz deal (up to 14 MHz paired) needs FCC approval and is not compatible with V1/V2 satellites. The SpaceX CFO targets mobile service in H1 2028, and SpaceX is undecided on building its own network or partnering with carriers (Light Reading).
Rates and the near-term tape: the 10-year was 5.22% on 2026-10-08 (FRED). Q3 on Oct 28 comes 48 hours after the FOMC and after the AT&T and Verizon prints, so the 1-month distribution is wide.
